ruleEarlyWindow: Windows are clipped at kick-off, so this is not yet a comparison of two full five-minute periods.
ruleRecoveriesExplanation: {name} recorded {count} attacking-third {recovery} in {range}. Only possession changes from an interception or tackle at x ≥ 66.67 count.
ruleRecoveriesCasual: {name} won the ball back {count} {times} in the third nearest the opponent's goal during this window.
ruleRecoveriesInterpretation: These recoveries may offer chances to attack closer to goal. They do not establish sustained pressure or guarantee a scoring chance.
ruleShotsExplanation: {name} recorded {recent} shots in {recentRange}, compared with {previous} in {previousRange}: an increase of {increase}.
ruleShotsCasual: {name} took more shots in the recent window than in the preceding one.
ruleShotsInterpretation: This may indicate more shooting activity, not better chances or a likely goal.
ruleShotsEarlyLimit: Unequal playing time in these early windows limits the comparison.
ruleShotsQualityLimit: Shot quality is not assessed by this count.
rulePassingExplanation: {name} completed {recentCompleted}/{recentCount} passes ({recentPercent}%) in {recentRange}, versus {previousCompleted}/{previousCount} ({previousPercent}%) in {previousRange}. Change: {change} (percentage points).
rulePassingLargerCasual: A larger share of {name}'s recent passes reached a teammate.
rulePassingSmallerCasual: A smaller share of {name}'s recent passes reached a teammate.
rulePassingInterpretation: This may reflect a change in passing execution, but pass difficulty, pressure and the small samples could also explain it. It does not prove a tactical change.
rulePlayerGoalHeadline: {name}: a goal in the recent window
rulePlayerExplanation: {name} recorded {actions} {actionWord}, including {goals} {goalWord}, in {range}. Actions count events credited to this player, not recipient or target mentions.
rulePlayerGoalCasual: {name} scored in this recent window; the goal is included in their {actions} recorded {actionWord}.
rulePlayerActionsCasual: {name} was involved in {actions} recorded actions in this window.
rulePlayerInterpretation: This highlights recent recorded involvement, not an overall player rating. Action counts alone cannot establish quality, off-ball influence or future performance.
